value.formula: creation drains (10 + sum of dimlet create costs) RF per tick for (100 + sum of dimlet tick costs) ticks; total RF is roughly the product. The Dimension Builder must hold each tick's cost or building stalls (DimensionBuilderTileEntity checks energy >= createCost per tick; infusion reduces the per-tick cost by the factor (2 - infusedFactor) / 2).

upkeep = 10 + sum of dimlet maintain costs, plus randomized (unknown-dimlet) maintain costs at a 0.1 factor (DimensionConfig.randomizedDimletCostFactor default). The upkeep is drawn from the dimension's own energy pool by PowerHandler (cost x 10 ticks per power pass), refilled through the Dimension Builder with the realized tab.

value.note: A dimension's maximum stored power scales with its upkeep cost between these bounds (PowerHandler.calculateMaxDimensionPower; cost thresholds minPowerThresshold 100 / maxPowerThresshold 5000). Expensive dimensions get bigger pools, not longer life: lifetime = pool / upkeep per tick.

rules.topic: What happens at zero dimension power in 11.0.11
rules.value: Version-specific: the classic lethal low-power damage is COMMENTED OUT in 11.0.11 (PowerHandler.handleLowPower). Active behavior: players carrying a valid Phased Field Generator receive slowness, mining fatigue and hunger debuffs while the dimension is unpowered. Do not promise instant death for an unpowered dimension on this version — but treat upkeep as mandatory anyway: the dimension is unusable for automation and the lethal path can return via config/other versions.

rules.topic: Invalid dimension tabs: dangling dimlets fail creation
rules.value: A material/fluid/attribute dimlet with no terrain or feature dimlet consuming it makes the descriptor invalid (DANGLING_BLOCKS / DANGLING_FLUIDS / DANGLING_ATTRIBUTES / DANGLING_TAGS) and the dimension cannot be created. Every material dimlet needs its consumer in the same tab.

rules.topic: Dimlet costs are datapack data shipped in the jar
rules.value: Every dimlet's rarity (common/uncommon/rare/legendary), create, maintain and ticks are JSON entries in data/rftoolsdim/dimletpackages/*.json (20 package files incl. per-mod packages for ae2, mekanism, botania, tconstruct, thermal...). Datapacks can override them, so live costs can differ from the jar defaults; the packages are layer-2 extractable.

rules.topic: Admin cheater dimlet zeroes all costs
rules.value: A tab containing the admin 'cheater' dimlet creates in 1 tick with zero creation and upkeep cost. Admin-only; its presence in a tab is the tell that a dimension was made in cheat mode.
